name: Sparking Arc
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level adept 1, bloodrager 1, druid 1, magus 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Effect 30-foot-line of electric bolts
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You spray bolts of electricity from your fingertips at your foe. While the spell is a 30-foot line, only the closest target to you is affected in each round. The affected target must make a Reflex save or be dealt 1d6 + 1 per caster level (max +5) electricity damage. You may elect to exclude the square adjacent to them from the area of effect if you so choose. Any creature wearing metal armor, wielding a metal weapon or is made of metal has a -3 penalty on their saving throw. If such a metal-exposed creature fails their Reflex save against this spell two rounds in a row, the damage that on any round they fail is multiplied by 1.5, once the target succeeds on the Reflex saving throw, the bonus damage ends. Each round while concentrating on the spell, you may redirect the line of effect.
